{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Theed.png|thumb|250px|The Theed Palace Plaza]]
Famous composer [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]] threw a '''charity concert''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] and [[Harp/Legends|harpist]] [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]] joined efforts with fellow musicians [[Bongiovi]], [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]] and [[Tofli Argala]] to persuade Pert to come out of retirement for a charity concert. The concert was held in the [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] and sold out, with all profits being used to support children orphaned by the Clone Wars on both sides of the conflict.<ref name="slugt1">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>
